stories.title: A customer story in one screen.
stories.summary: A named customer, a specific benefit, and a reason to keep reading.
facts: Resend aims to fit a customer story in one viewport, with a descriptive title and a prominent customer quote.
In the Layer example, the co-founder describes getting set up within 30 seconds. Developers can create and use their own email templates.
Developer Markepear’s annotated breakdown points out the visible customer, clear benefits and named person behind the quote.

image.alt: Developer Markepear’s annotated Resend story about Layer, highlighting the quote, benefits, customer and testimonial.
image.credit: Annotations: Developer Markepear. Customer story: Resend / Layer. Included for editorial commentary; excluded from the code license.

stories.title: Let competitors correct the comparison.
stories.summary: PostHog accepted an Amplitude correction. Four claims fixed, in public.
facts: PostHog reports over 25,000 signups after comparison-content reads since 2021. This is association, not proof of incremental conversions.
Shared data files let a correction flow through to every comparison page using it.
An Amplitude contribution corrected four feature claims. PostHog describes merging it the same day.

stories.title: Leave a little room before launch day.
stories.summary: Ship early. Use the final week to test the experience people will actually have.
facts: Ant Wilson’s 2021 account separates shipping from wider promotion: existing users can get features before launch week.
After live-debugging production during an earlier launch, Supabase aimed to finish major integrations a week early.
The final week includes testing with people outside the team, while keeping launch scope flexible.
